title: Northgate Memberships Loyalty Schedule: Member Pickup Loyalty Rate on Special Order Pickups
content:
Membership loyalty schedule for the member pickup fee that Northgate Purchases & Returns charges on the changed-mind freight pickup of Northgate Special Order merchandise for a consumer-segment membership. The rate turns on the presenting membership's tier and its opened date on the Northgate Memberships record.

## Member pickup loyalty rate

When the membership is a Northgate Club Plus Membership opened 60 months or more before today, the member pickup fee is computed at 0.5 of the sum; when it is a Northgate Club Plus Membership opened less than 60 months before today, or a Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club or Club Membership opened 60 months or more before today, it is computed at 0.8 of the sum; otherwise it is the full sum (1).

- **The sum** is the member pickup fee's charges added together, less any amounts taken off, a sum below zero being taken as zero.
- **Application:** the loyalty rate is applied once to that sum, and only the final member pickup fee is rounded half up to the cent.

| Presenting membership | Opened before today | Rate applied to the sum |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | 60 months or more | 0.5 |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | less than 60 months | 0.8 |
| Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club or Club Membership | 60 months or more | 0.8 |
| Northgate Student Club, Heroes Club or Club Membership | less than 60 months | 1 (full sum) |

## Worked rates (hypothetical sums)

A sum of 102.00 at 0.5 gives 51.00; at 0.8 it gives 81.60; in full it stays 102.00. A sum of 96.33 at 0.5 gives 48.165, rounded half up to 48.17.
